name: voicedraft-root
description: VoiceDraft AI Voice Writing Assistant - Wispr Flow Architecture

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix desktop
scripts.copy-backend: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src=path.join('backend', 'dist'); const dest=path.join('desktop', 'backend-dist'); if(fs.existsSync(dest)) fs.rmSync(dest, {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.cpSync(src, dest, {recursive:true}); console.log('Backend copied to desktop.');"
scripts.build: npm run build:helper && npm run build:backend && npm run copy-backend && npm run build:desktop
scripts.test: node test/test_formatting.js && node test/test_audio_stream.js && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File desktop/native-helper/test_helper.ps1
scripts.dev: npm run build:backend && npm run copy-backend && concurrently "tsc -w --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix desktop"
